text:
ina: small experiment: I asked the sandbox LLM to 'try on' three plant personas and tweet them as office bios. results are chaotic. 😂
kevin: please tell me one was 'overworked pothos who critiques meetings'
nina: it's 'Pothos, MS in Passive-Aggressive Photosynthesis' i am screaming. paste pls
sam: also did it demand a desk window? that's the hill we die on. :seedling:
nina: pasted (abridged):
```
Name: Pothos Prime (they/them)
Bio: I photosynthesize between standups. I RSVP to water. I provide unsolicited feedback on meeting agendas and PR titles.
Special skills: passive-aggressive leaf-turning, timeout suggestions, memetic humidity control.
```
kevin: we should make merch. t-shirts: "I provide unsolicited feedback on PR titles"
sam: poll: which persona should be resident fic mascot? A) Stoic Fern B) Pothos Prime C) Dramatic Succulent D) Debugging Daisy
plant-bot: Poll created: react with :one: :two: :three: :four: (expires in 8h)
nina: also it wrote a tiny 'onboarding checklist' for new plants. includes: 'introduce to quiet chair, avoid spicy snacks, and do not explain git to them.'
nina: code haiku it produced (10/10):
```
low light, long memory
buffers full of yesterday's sun
please water, not pity
```
kevin: adding haiku to my commit message policy. mandatory if PR touches docs.
sam: ops-bot, can you add 'introduce Pothos Prime' to the office checklist?
ops-bot: Task created: "Introduce Pothos Prime to team" assigned to @kevin. Reminder set for tomorrow 10:00 AM.
nina: vote results so far are leaning Pothos Prime. this is the most civilized product launch ever.
kevin: next step: get the model to write a passive-aggressive standup one-liner for Monday. sample: "I have no blockers, but the humidity is low."
nina: love that. small ask: don't actually feed the plants leftover coffee. they asked politely and I said no. :coffee: -> humans only. :seedling:
plant-bot: Reminder: "Water fic plants" scheduled for tomorrow 10:05 AM — @kevin
ina: ok team, campaign to make Pothos Prime official starts now. low stakes, high charm. keep the persona ideas coming.
